text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d w-i-t-h t-w-o c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r-s t-o a-l-i-g-n c-o-v-e-r-b-i-d s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g m-e-t-a d-a-t-a t-r-a-c-i-n-g a-n-d d-i-s-c-r-e-p-a-n-c-y i-n p-r-i-c-i-n-g, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t b-i-d c-a-l-c-u-l-a-t-i-o-n s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d-s.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d c-o-s-t e-s-t-i-m-a-t-e-s a-c-r-o-s-s f-i-r-m-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g c-h-a-t l-o-g s a-n-d e-m-a-i-l t-h-r-e-a-d-s a-s a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-s-o-l-a-t-e-d b-i-d-d-i-n-g p-r-e-p-a-r-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e-s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e-d a c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n m-o-d-e-l f-o-r w-i-n-n-i-n-g b-i-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g i-n-v-o-i-c-e d-r-a-f-t-s a-n-d p-a-y-m-e-n-t r-e-c-e-i-p-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t o-f i-n-t-e-r-e-s-t d-e-c-l-a-r-a-t-i-o-n-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-f-i-n-e-d a b-i-d r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r f-o-r t-h-e s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e o-f w-i-n-n-e-r-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-h-a-r-e-d s-p-r-e-a-d-s-h-e-e-t-s i-n a n-o-u-n i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n f-o-l-d-e-r, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g r-a-n-d-o-m-i-z-a-t-i-o-n v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-r-e-s-e-n-t-e-d c-o-v-e-r b-i-d-d-e-r-s a-s i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t c-a-n-d-i-d-a-t-e-s t-o t-h-e e-v-a-l-u-a-t-o-r-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a f-a-l-s-e c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e p-r-o-f-i-l-e i-n t-h-e r-e-c-o-r-d, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g b-a-c-k-g-r-o-u-n-d c-h-e-c-k-s a-n-d v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d-s.
